t: Increase the range of machines that have a working area, not all machines accept range addons. Each tier increases the range by 1.
提升具有工作区域之机器的作用范围；但并非所有机器均支持范围升级卡。每级升级使范围增加1格。
Increase how much the progress bar advances every tick. $(br2)Tier 1 -> +1$(br)Tier 2 -> +2
提升进度条每刻所推进的数值。$(br2)等级一 → +1$(br)等级二 → +2
Decreases the amount of ticks need to complete an operation. $(br2)Tier 1 -> -10%$(br)Tier 2 -> -20%
减少完成一次操作所需的刻数。$(br2)等级一 → -10%$(br)等级二 → -20%
Increased the amount of operations done when a machine finishes processing. $(br2)Tier 1 -> +1 Operation $(br)Tier 2 -> +2 Operations
增加机器完成处理时执行的操作次数。$(br2)1 级 -> +1 次操作 $(br)2 级 -> +2 次操作
